question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in each place?
premises: Meditation is performed in each and every place.
The object meditated upon extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
This range covers the whole spectrum of reality.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that which pervades from Śiva to Avīci.
